nodes.label: data/where-are-we.json (AI-edited file)
nodes.rationale: Single file AI edits so the board stays current without the user maintaining it; keeps AI writes isolated from user layout state.

nodes.label: data/NEXT.md breadcrumb
nodes.rationale: Generated so an AI can instantly know the next move after a context reset; never edited directly.

nodes.label: data/layout.local.json (user layout)
nodes.rationale: Holds the user's hand-arranged layout and personal edits/overrides; must never be edited by the AI.

nodes.label: project node (milestone)
nodes.rationale: Powers flowchart layout, gold critical path, and the Do this next banner - accuracy of blockedBy matters.

nodes.label: board edges (start -> finish flow)
nodes.rationale: Edges also count as dependencies for the critical path calculation.

nodes.label: graphify query/update workflow
nodes.rationale: Run graphify query before drawing edges/blockedBy so dependencies reflect real code structure, not guesses; run graphify update after modifying code.

nodes.label: Card copy writing rules
nodes.rationale: Titles <=6 words, plain outcome language, no invented internal nouns or acronyms, ASCII-only to avoid UTF-8/Windows-1252 mangling corruption of the JSON file.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md hard rules
nodes.rationale: Never repurpose an id, always keep valid JSON, never set colors manually (status drives color), bump updatedAt only when there is real news.

nodes.label: The Architect's Sketchbook (creative north star)
nodes.rationale: Resolves the tension between crayon medium and childishness risk: hand-drawn but by someone doing serious technical work. Every design decision is measured against this line.

nodes.label: Slate and Chalk color system
nodes.rationale: Near-black slate board plus warm off-white chalk ink, with pigment reserved almost entirely for semantic meaning (status).

nodes.label: The One Loud Thing Rule
nodes.rationale: Gold marks exactly one card, the next action; highlighting the whole critical path highlights nothing, so only one card may glow.

nodes.label: The Semantic Pigment Rule
nodes.rationale: Status colours are prohibited as decoration; a colour appearing where it doesn't convey state is a bug.

nodes.label: The Contrast Floor Rule
nodes.rationale: Every status label must clear 4.5:1 contrast in both themes; light ramp deepened deliberately rather than lightened toward prettier pastels.

nodes.label: Typography system (Patrick Hand)
nodes.rationale: One hand writes everything; a second display face would read as costume, so hierarchy comes from size/weight/case only.

nodes.label: The Grows-When-Small Rule
nodes.rationale: Text scales up as the board zooms out, never down; legibility is preserved by dropping detail, not shrinking type.

nodes.label: The Six Word Rule
nodes.rationale: Long titles are a content bug, not a layout problem; fix the words, not the clamp.

nodes.label: Elevation model (flat board, floating tools)
nodes.rationale: Canvas is dead paper with no shadow; depth exists only where chrome genuinely floats above the board (top bar, toolbar).

nodes.label: The Ink-Not-Object Rule
nodes.rationale: A card is a mark on the page, never an object resting on it; giving a card a shadow kills the sketchbook illusion.

nodes.label: The Earned Blur Rule
nodes.rationale: backdrop-filter permitted only on the two surfaces persistently floating over live canvas; blur as a default look is prohibited.

nodes.label: Component vocabulary (buttons, chips, cards, inputs, nav)
nodes.norm_label: component vocabulary (buttons, chips, cards, inputs, nav)

nodes.label: The drawn stroke (signature component)
nodes.rationale: Every card/section/edge/arrowhead generated by rough.js and animated with stroke-dashoffset; one pass only, since multi-stroke reads as a confused double line. Reduced-motion resolves instantly to fully visible rather than being suppressed invisibly.

nodes.label: Design Do's and Don'ts
nodes.rationale: Explicit anti-patterns: no generic SaaS dashboard, no childish toy look, no cluttered whiteboard, no cold corporate correction.

nodes.label: Canvas reliability phased plan (0-6)
nodes.rationale: Phased execution plan: orient/reproduce, camera fix, draw-in vanish fix, pins/edges, readable cards, card resize, verify+polish.

nodes.label: Camera init race / flash-to-black bug
nodes.rationale: Saved camera sets cameraInitRef before ELK fills viewRects, so fit is skipped forever, leaving an off-screen black viewport.

nodes.label: DrawnPath cancel leaves invisible strokes
nodes.rationale: anim.cancel() leaves full strokeDashoffset, producing invisible paths after re-layout or rapid AI edits.

nodes.label: Pins, edges, new-card placement bugs
nodes.rationale: ELK ignores pinned positions causing collisions; nodeSize ignores title length causing overlap/clipping; new nodes omitted until ELK resolves.

nodes.label: Readable cards + AI guidance (Phase 4)
nodes.rationale: Include title wrap/length in nodeSize(); tighten AGENTS.md guidance to short titles/one-line notes.

nodes.label: Card resize (Phase 5)
nodes.rationale: NodePos already supports optional w/h but there is no resize UI; add corner/edge drag handle persisting into layout.pinned.

nodes.label: Verify + polish (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: tsc/build must stay green; smoke test on Boostl .waw data; update HANDOVER.md; run graphify update .

nodes.label: Where Are We v2 status (verification complete)
nodes.rationale: v2 is DONE and fully verified; build passes; full browser verification checklist passed.
nodes.norm_label: where are we v2 status (verification complete)

nodes.label: 2026-07-24 canvas reliability pass
nodes.rationale: Root cause of reported flash-to-black was a stale v1 dist/ build served against v2 server layout (missing layout.positions), causing a TypeError and React unmount.

nodes.label: Camera rescue fix
nodes.rationale: Saved camera is verified once ELK produces real rects (contentVisible); auto-fits if it frames empty space instead of staying black. Any user setCamera marks the camera checked and is never overridden.

nodes.label: DrawnPath cancel safety fix
nodes.rationale: Effect cleanup clears inline dasharray/dashoffset after anim.cancel() so interrupted draw-ins can no longer leave permanently invisible strokes.

nodes.label: Pins + new cards + edges fix
nodes.rationale: New nodes get immediate placeholder rects; auto-laid cards nudged off pinned cards; routeEdge() falls back to orthogonal A* over a 30px grid when a straight edge would cut through a card.

nodes.label: Readable cards fix
nodes.rationale: nodeSize() models the real card (status row + wrapped title clamped 3 + note clamped 4 + chip); .node-title line-clamped at 3 in CSS; AGENTS.md/CLI init/.cursor rule updated with title/note length guidance.

nodes.label: Card resize shipped feature
nodes.rationale: Selected card shows bottom-right corner handle; dragging persists {x,y,w,h} into layout.pinned (min 140x74); undo works via resize-<id> key; Auto-arrange clears size with the pin.

nodes.label: Data files split (where-are-we.json / presets.json / layout.local.json / NEXT.md)
nodes.rationale: Split exists so saved arrangements travel between machines while volatile per-machine state (camera, in-progress pins, scribbles) doesn't create merge conflicts; server owns the split and migrates presets out of older layout.local.json on first run.
nodes.norm_label: data files split (where-are-we.json / presets.json / layout.local.json / next.md)

nodes.label: Known gaps / owner questions (batched)
nodes.rationale: Section frames as member bounding boxes can stretch across the board when a pin is far outside its section; deliberate v2 behavior, redesign only if it bothers the owner. Resize handle look and title-clamp aggressiveness are taste calls.

nodes.label: Product users (solo founder / small-team builder)
nodes.rationale: Job to be done: see project state in one glance, know what to do next without deciding, see that today produced something - has to make sense cold after a break/context switch.

nodes.label: Product purpose (live board, believed not groomed)
nodes.rationale: Success is that the board is believed and glanced at daily rather than tidied/ignored/abandoned like other project trackers; if the user has to groom it, it has failed.
nodes.norm_label: product purpose (live board, believed not groomed)

nodes.label: Brand personality (hand-drawn, calm, credible)
nodes.rationale: Voice is plain and direct, no cheerleading or exclamation marks; the board states facts and gets out of the way.

nodes.label: Anti-references (SaaS dashboard, childish, cluttered whiteboard, cold corporate)
nodes.rationale: Childish/toy-like flagged as the sharpest risk since the medium is literally crayon; the line is hand-drawn by an adult for adult work.
nodes.norm_label: anti-references (saas dashboard, childish, cluttered whiteboard, cold corporate)

nodes.label: Product design principles
nodes.rationale: Board is the product not the chrome; answer 'where am I?' in one glance; hand-drawn not hand-made (precision underneath, looseness on the surface); quiet by default, loud only where it matters; readable cold.

nodes.label: Accessibility & inclusion defaults
nodes.rationale: prefers-reduced-motion honoured by degrading to instant fully-visible state rather than being skipped in a way that hides geometry; status never carried by colour alone; zoom treated as a first-class accessibility affordance.

nodes.label: Board features (sections, auto-layout, critical path, do this next, daily view)
nodes.norm_label: board features (sections, auto-layout, critical path, do this next, daily view)

nodes.label: Canvas tools (pan, move, draw, connect, card, erase)
nodes.rationale: Overrides to AI cards (status/title/note) are stored in the layout file as overrides; if the AI later updates the card, its fresh content wins and the stale override is dropped.
nodes.norm_label: canvas tools (pan, move, draw, connect, card, erase)
